findingForms.variable: a variable-name string or an object with a name field
findingForms.located: a path:name string or an object with path and name fields

semantics.definedAndUsed: defined in an environment file and statically referenced by project source
semantics.definedUnconfirmedUnused: defined but not found by the supported static reference scan; not evidence that deletion is safe
semantics.usedUndefined: statically referenced but absent from environment definitions
semantics.hardcodedSecrets: a sensitive-named binding assigned a string literal outside environment files
semantics.exposureRisks: a sensitive variable using a configured client prefix at a source reference
semantics.schemaRequired: true exactly when the variable is statically referenced
semantics.schemaRules: derive type, URI format, range, sensitivity, and minimum length from the public policy patterns
semantics.additionalMetadata: allowed when it does not contradict the required semantic fields
